chapterInfo.content:
12
Misraim tu Yuda so sa
(1 Ahemfo 14.25-28)
1 # 1 Ah 14.21-31 Na Rehoboam ahennie timiiɛ, na ɔyɛɛ den no, ɔgyaa AWURADE mmara, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho.
2Na Ɔhene Rehoboam afe a ɛtɔ so nnum no Misraimhene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem so, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔafom AWURADE. 3Ɔde nteaseɛnam apem ahanu ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpemaduosia bae, na ɛdɔm a wɔne no baeɛ no nni ano, wɔfiri Misraim: Libiafoɔ, Sukifoɔ ne Etiopiafoɔ. 4#2 Be 11.5-10 Na ɔgyee Yuda nkuro a ɛyɛ den no, na ɔbɛduruu Yerusalem. 5Ɛnna Odiyifoɔ Semaia baa Rehoboam ne Yuda mmapɔmma a wɔaboa wɔn ano aba Yerusalem afiri Sisak anim no nkyɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mo deɛ, moagya me, na me nso magyaa mo ahyɛ Sisak nsa. 6Ɛnna Israel mmapɔmma ne ɔhene no brɛɛ wɔn ho aseɛ, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔteneneeni ne AWURADE. 7Na AWURADE hunuu sɛ wɔabrɛ wɔn ho aseɛ no, AWURADE asɛm baa Semaia nkyɛn sɛ: Wɔabrɛ wɔn ho ase nti, merensɛe wɔn, na ɛyɛ kakra a mɛma wɔafiri mu afi, na m’abufuo amfa Sisak nsa so anhwie angu Yerusalem so. 8Nanso wɔbɛyɛ no nkoa, na wɔahunu me som ne nsase so ahennie som no. 9Na Misraimhene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem bɛfaa AWURADE fie akoradeɛ ne ɔhene fie akoradeɛ no, — ne nyinaa na ɔfaeɛ, — na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Salomo yɛeɛ no nso. 10Na Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ akyɛm sisii ananmu, na ɔde hyehyɛɛ awɛmfoɔ a wɔwɛn ɔhene fie pono ano no asafohene no nsa. 11Na da biara a ɔhene ba AWURADE fie no, awɛmfoɔ no bɛsoa kɔ na wɔde asane aba awɛmfoɔ no dan mu. 12Na ɛnam sɛ ɔbrɛɛ ne ho aseɛ nti, AWURADE abufuo no sane firii ne so, sɛ ɔrensɛe no nwie; na ɔmannwoeɛ wɔ Yuda mu nso.
Rehoboam nnisoɔ no awieeɛ
13 # 2 Be 6.20 Na Ɔhene Rehoboam hyɛɛ ne ho den wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔdii hene. Na ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduanan baako, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia dunson wɔ Yerusalem a ɛne kuro a AWURADE yii Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no. Na ne na din de Naama a ɔyɛ Amonni. 14Na ɔyɛɛ bɔne, na wamfa n’akoma anhwehwɛ AWURADE.
15 # 2 Be 13.22 Na Rehoboam ho nsɛm, kane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ nso, wɔantwerɛ no Odiyifoɔ Semaia ne ɔdehunufoɔ Ido nsɛm mu antoatoa so? Na akodie daa Rehoboam ne Yeroboam ntam nna nyinaa. 16Na Rehoboam tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro no mu. Na ne ba Abia bɛdii n’adeɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Rehoboam ahennie timiiɛ, na ɔyɛɛ den no, ɔgyaa AWURADE mmara, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho.
Na Ɔhene Rehoboam afe a ɛtɔ so nnum no Misraimhene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem so, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔafom AWURADE. Ɔde nteaseɛnam apem ahanu ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpemaduosia bae, na ɛdɔm a wɔne no baeɛ no nni ano, wɔfiri Misraim: Libiafoɔ, Sukifoɔ ne Etiopiafoɔ. Na ɔgyee Yuda nkuro a ɛyɛ den no, na ɔbɛduruu Yerusalem. Ɛnna Odiyifoɔ Semaia baa Rehoboam ne Yuda mmapɔmma a wɔaboa wɔn ano aba Yerusalem afiri Sisak anim no nkyɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mo deɛ, moagya me, na me nso magyaa mo ahyɛ Sisak nsa. Ɛnna Israel mmapɔmma ne ɔhene no brɛɛ wɔn ho aseɛ, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔteneneeni ne AWURADE. Na AWURADE hunuu sɛ wɔabrɛ wɔn ho aseɛ no, AWURADE asɛm baa Semaia nkyɛn sɛ: Wɔabrɛ wɔn ho ase nti, merensɛe wɔn, na ɛyɛ kakra a mɛma wɔafiri mu afi, na m’abufuo amfa Sisak nsa so anhwie angu Yerusalem so. Nanso wɔbɛyɛ no nkoa, na wɔahunu me som ne nsase so ahennie som no. Na Misraimhene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem bɛfaa AWURADE fie akoradeɛ ne ɔhene fie akoradeɛ no, — ne nyinaa na ɔfaeɛ, — na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Salomo yɛeɛ no nso. Na Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ akyɛm sisii ananmu, na ɔde hyehyɛɛ awɛmfoɔ a wɔwɛn ɔhene fie pono ano no asafohene no nsa. Na da biara a ɔhene ba AWURADE fie no, awɛmfoɔ no bɛsoa kɔ na wɔde asane aba awɛmfoɔ no dan mu. Na ɛnam sɛ ɔbrɛɛ ne ho aseɛ nti, AWURADE abufuo no sane firii ne so, sɛ ɔrensɛe no nwie; na ɔmannwoeɛ wɔ Yuda mu nso.

Na Ɔhene Rehoboam hyɛɛ ne ho den wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔdii hene. Na ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduanan baako, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia dunson wɔ Yerusalem a ɛne kuro a AWURADE yii Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no. Na ne na din de Naama a ɔyɛ Amonni. Na ɔyɛɛ bɔne, na wamfa n’akoma anhwehwɛ AWURADE.
Na Rehoboam ho nsɛm, kane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ nso, wɔantwerɛ no Odiyifoɔ Semaia ne ɔdehunufoɔ Ido nsɛm mu antoatoa so? Na akodie daa Rehoboam ne Yeroboam ntam nna nyinaa. Na Rehoboam tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro no mu. Na ne ba Abia bɛdii n’adeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
